decisions.reason: The curation expansion does not require an additional answer-layer change; the same-message Event already records the revised mandatory layers, conditional layers, and framework placement.
Permission to curate existing categories and questions does not alter this separately required new chapter, whose same-message format and question-count policy are already recorded.
The existing-question curation options do not change the independently required AI chapter; its same-message format and length limit are already represented.
The curation rules for the existing question set do not modify this new question-and-answer chapter, and its same-message question-count policy is already recorded.
The source curation change does not alter the separately specified remote and hybrid leadership chapter; its same-message format and question-count policy are already represented.
The expanded curation options for existing content do not change this new chapter, whose same-message format, audience focus, and word limit are already recorded.
Allowing additional curation actions does not change how global differences must be integrated into the book.
The first-milestone curation output does not revise the established overall duration, flexibility, or sequential milestone order.
The source modifies the contracted book-curation scope after the pre-project test and does not change the test deliverables or timing.
The expanded curation options remain subject to the already recorded 50,000-word cap and do not change the existing word-budget attributes.
